title: Meridian Workhouse
brief: A flexible workplace shaped around daylight, focused collaboration, and a distinctly human material palette.
overview: Meridian replaces the conventional office corridor with a sequence of social rooms, quiet work zones, and planted thresholds. Teams can move between different modes of work without losing visual connection.
Acoustic surfaces, warm timber, and precise lighting bring a domestic calm to the workplace. Modular planning allows the organization to evolve without compromising the original spatial idea.
